### ① Derived judgments

**Head and diff.** `git rev-parse refs/review/pr-10495` = `a8aded687b830a7d923f5e34e3401aeda783621b` (matches). Merge-base with main `cdefa2a06`; two commits: `32c4b7b47` (test edit) and `a8aded687` (changeset only). Diff: 2 files, +40/-2. Checkout untouched (`git status --short` empty).

**`label` is the right key — verified three ways.**
- Spec: `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0` from npm, `RecordDetailsProps.safeParse` via the `./ui` subpath (zod ^4.4.3 installed in scratch): base `{ sections: [{ name: 'main', title: 'Main', fields: [...] }] }` gives `success=false`, `unrecognized_keys` at path `["sections",0]`, keys `["title"]`; head `{ ..., label: 'Main', ... }` gives `success=true`; both keys together is refused on `title`. Spec source `src/ui/component.zod.ts` sections entry declares `name` and `label` (I18nLabelSchema), no `title`.
- Types: `packages/types/src/record-components.ts` lines 128-131 declare `name?: string; label?: string;` on the `sections[]` entry, no `title`.
- Renderer: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` line 689 `const rawTitleSrc = s.label;` with the comment "`label` is the ONE heading slot (objectui#6190)", then `sectionLabel(objectName, s.name, rawTitle ?? s.name)`. `sectionLabel` (`packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` line 531, identity fallback at 704) returns the fallback verbatim, so a `label`-less entry renders the raw name `main`, not a prettified `Main`.

**The read-back is real, not vacuous.** `queryAllByText(SAMPLE_SECTION_LABEL)` is exact, case-sensitive, and matches element text nodes only: the base spelling's output `main` does not match `Main`. No other `Main` exists anywhere in the mount: RECORD_A values are `Probe Alpha` / `first probe record` / `4413` / `qualified`; field labels are ID/Name/Description/Amount/Stage; object label `Probe Object`; `showHeader: false`. Scope note: the assertion scans the whole `record:details` render (`a.html` = `container.innerHTML`) rather than a heading node, and uses `toBeGreaterThan(0)` rather than exactly 1, so it would also be satisfied by `Main` appearing as a field value; with today's fixture no such string exists, so it discriminates. Looser than ideal, not a defect. The `within(host)` on a detached div is valid for testing-library.

**Gating to `record:details` is correct.** `git grep "name: 'sections'"` over packages/ and apps/ (non-test): plugin-detail `detail-view` (not `record:*`), plugin-detail `register('details', …, { namespace: 'record', skipFallback: true })` at index.tsx line 430 (= `record:details`), plugin-form `object-form`/`form`, plugin-designer, and the preview block-config. None of the other 10 `record:*` candidates declares `sections`.

**Sibling sweep — my own grep agrees: only this one.** `git grep -E "\b(title|label)\s*:"` over `apps/console/src/__tests__/` at head (34 files, count verified). Every `sections:` sample spells `label`: formPageRequiredMarker-10178:69, formViewFeaturesRootRefused-6262:56 and :68, public-block-binding-reach:348. Remaining `title:` hits are declared inputs (component-input-union-specimens `page:header`/`page:card`/`record:alert`; record-block-record-reach:258 `record:alert`; tabTitleAfterNavigation:80 branding), object field names (formPageRequiredMarker:55, internalFormShell:143/149), and public-block-binding-reach:371 `{ childObject, title: 'Probe Detail' }` on `object-master-detail-form.details`, where `title` is canonical: `MasterDetailDetailConfig.title` (`packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx` line 70) and the spec `subforms` entry in `src/ui/view.zod.ts` line 3347 declares `title` with alias `label: 'title'`.

### ② Semver level

Empty-frontmatter changeset is correct and required. The touched test lives under `apps/console/src/`, which `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` guards as published source (rule (a), package `src/**`, no markdown subtraction), and `@object-ui/console` is in the `fixed` group of `.changeset/config.json` (40 packages). AGENTS.md line 168 names the empty frontmatter (`---` directly followed by `---`) as the first-class "test-only, no release" spelling. `.changeset/7321-record-reach-sections-label.md` carries exactly that (`cat -A` confirms `---$` `---$`). Prose is true on every claim I could check: the refusal (safeParse above), "renderer no longer reads since objectui#6190" (record-details.tsx line 680-689), and "falls back to the section `name`" (`rawTitle ?? s.name` plus identity fallback).
